messages.content: Summarize the text in one sentence of at most 25 words. Plain text only, no preamble, no bullet points.

We measured how often three small language models change their answer to a fixed prompt across 30 days. With greedy decoding and a fixed seed, local models were stable, while hosted models changed 3 to 8 percent of outputs, usually after undocumented backend updates.

response.text: Three small language models changed their answers to a fixed prompt 3 to 8 percent of the time, mostly after undocumented backend updates.
